four_sides.factual: Reduces the task to basic self-care steps
four_sides.self_revelation: Knows what is possible inside acute grief
four_sides.relationship: Treats the poster as someone who needs the bar lowered
four_sides.appeal: Do only these small things for now

segments.why: Scales the demand down to what a grieving person can manage

segments.quote: You got this and you are not alone.

four_sides.factual: Asserts the poster can endure and is not alone
four_sides.self_revelation: Wants to hold the person up
four_sides.relationship: Stands with the poster as company
four_sides.appeal: Believe you can get through and that people are here

segments.why: Answers isolation with presence and encouragement

segments.quote: Sending all the love possible <3

four_sides.factual: Sends love
four_sides.self_revelation: Gives what can be given at a distance
four_sides.relationship: Closes warmly

segments.why: Closes by extending as much warmth as the medium allows

segments.quote: Sorry for your loss

four_sides.factual: Offers condolence
four_sides.self_revelation: Wants to mark the loss briefly
four_sides.relationship: Acknowledges the poster without elaboration

segments.why: Marks another's loss with a minimal act of acknowledgement

segments.quote: I'm so so sorry.

four_sides.factual: Offers condolence with emphasis
four_sides.self_revelation: Is affected by the account
four_sides.relationship: Leads with sympathy before the reassurance

segments.why: Leads with emphatic condolence before anything else

segments.quote: I know you've heard this countless times but please don't blame yourselves.

four_sides.factual: Urges the parents not to blame themselves while acknowledging the advice is repetitive
four_sides.self_revelation: Says it anyway because it matters more than novelty
four_sides.relationship: Treats the poster's guilt as the thing to address

segments.why: Aims directly at the stated guilt and asks that it be set down

segments.quote: SIDS has been studied for decades and they've yet to figure it out.

four_sides.factual: States that the cause remains unexplained despite decades of research
four_sides.self_revelation: Reaches for evidence to make the reassurance stick
four_sides.relationship: Gives the poster something outside feeling to lean on
four_sides.appeal: Let the science release you from blame

segments.why: Supplies a fact to dislodge self-blame, the care carried by the evidence

segments.quote: Beautiful family photo x

four_sides.factual: Praises the photo of the family
four_sides.self_revelation: Looks at what was shared and finds beauty in it
four_sides.relationship: Honours the family as a family rather than a tragedy

segments.why: Praises a family photograph as a gentle act of honouring

segments.quote: This was in no way caused by anything you did.

four_sides.factual: Denies any causal role for the parents' actions
four_sides.self_revelation: Will state it as certainty rather than hedge
four_sides.relationship: Addresses the stated guilt head on

segments.why: Cuts against stated self-blame with an unhedged denial

segments.quote: You sound like an amazing dad and I know John was loved and cared for.

four_sides.factual: Judges the poster a good father and the baby well loved
four_sides.self_revelation: Reads the post as evidence of devotion
four_sides.relationship: Restores the poster's standing as a parent
four_sides.appeal: See yourself as the father you were

segments.why: Restores a parent's standing by naming the love visible in the post

segments.quote: I am so sorry you are dealing with this heavy pain.

four_sides.factual: Offers condolence for the ongoing pain
four_sides.self_revelation: Registers the weight of it
four_sides.relationship: Stays with the poster in the present tense of it

segments.why: Closes with sympathy pitched at the pain still being carried

segments.quote: It was not ‘heaven’ as we have been conditioned to think of it.

four_sides.factual: Denies that what was seen matched the conventional idea of heaven
four_sides.self_revelation: Speaks from a direct experience and distrusts inherited images
four_sides.relationship: Corrects the frame the thread has been using

segments.why: Corrects an inherited frame with a first-hand account, stated without heat

segments.quote: It was blue like the center of this nebula.

four_sides.factual: Describes what was seen as blue like a nebula's centre
four_sides.self_revelation: Reaches for an image precise enough to convey it
four_sides.relationship: Gives the reader something concrete to picture

segments.why: Reaches for a concrete image to convey something hard to describe

segments.quote: [https://apod.nasa.gov/apod/ap230814.html](https://apod.nasa.gov/apod/ap230814.html)

four_sides.factual: Links the specific astronomical image referred to
four_sides.self_revelation: Wants the description to be checkable rather than vague
four_sides.relationship: Hands the reader the picture directly

segments.why: Supplies the exact image so the description can be seen rather than taken on trust

segments.quote: I don't really believe in an afterlife, but man, my brother really grieved my mom's death, and my sister's death.

four_sides.factual: Disclaims belief in an afterlife while reporting a brother's heavy grief for mother and sister
four_sides.self_revelation: Holds disbelief and tenderness at once without resolving them
four_sides.relationship: Enters the thread honestly rather than adopting its premise
four_sides.appeal: Take the honesty and the feeling together

segments.why: Names disbelief and family loss in the same breath, neither one softened

segments.quote: When he died, if he joined them, I hope he finally found the peace he struggled so hard to find.

four_sides.factual: Wishes the dead brother the peace he never found in life
four_sides.self_revelation: Wants something for him even without believing in it
four_sides.relationship: Meets the thread's hope on conditional terms
four_sides.appeal: Let the wish stand even without the belief

segments.why: Wishes peace for the dead while keeping the condition honest

segments.quote: I hope so too.

four_sides.factual: Endorses the poster's hope of reunion
four_sides.self_revelation: Holds the same hope
four_sides.relationship: Aligns with the poster

segments.why: Joins a shared hope about the dead in plain words

segments.quote: My daughter will meet me again one day

four_sides.factual: States as certainty that the dead daughter will be met again
four_sides.self_revelation: Has lost a child and holds the reunion as settled
four_sides.relationship: Offers the poster a firmer version of their hope
four_sides.appeal: Hold this as certain rather than hoped

segments.why: States a reunion with a dead child as settled, the longing carried without collapse
